changelog: 5.0.0: user requested 150 retrieval-only cases, replacing the mixed-capability acceptance scope while preserving historical v1-v4 files.
Reuse 65 former RAG questions with source.legacy_id mapping; rewrite the other 85 using actual published article evidence. New IDs rag-001 through rag-150.
19 frozen Java-authorized published articles; original seven content hashes unchanged. External papers contribute only their on-site guides.
Evaluate production vector, BM25 and hybrid RRF retrieval on the same indexed corpus; no chat generation, LLM Judge or Reranker.
Keep source/topic groups in one split. Report article relevance over chunk ranks, per-case hits, errors, zero-relevance false positives and all-source recall checks.
